REST_CONFIRM.TITLE: Confirm Rest
REST_CONFIRM.CONTENT: Are you sure you want to rest?

COMBAT_AUTOMATION.NAME: Combat automation in chat
COMBAT_AUTOMATION.HINT: Enable combat action buttons in attack roll chat cards (dodge, parry, armor, apply damage).

REST_CONFIRMATION.NAME: Rest confirmation dialog
REST_CONFIRMATION.HINT: Show a confirmation popup before executing the Rest action on character sheets.

INJURY_HEALING.NAME: Critical injury healing countdown
INJURY_HEALING.HINT: Automatically count down each critical injury's healing time as in-game days pass on the calendar, removing the injury and announcing recovery when it heals.

MERCHANT_AUTOMATION.NAME: Merchant automation
MERCHANT_AUTOMATION.HINT: Roll availability and quantity when items are added to a merchant, and let players buy from the merchant sheet.

MERCHANT_ANNOUNCE.NAME: Announce purchases in chat
MERCHANT_ANNOUNCE.HINT: Post a public chat message whenever a character buys something from a merchant.

PRICE_MIGRATION.NAME: Price migration
PRICE_MIGRATION.HINT: Parse every item's Cost and Supply text into the module's structured price and rarity fields. The system's own fields are never changed.
PRICE_MIGRATION.TITLE: Price Migration
PRICE_MIGRATION.SCOPE_WORLD: Items in the world Items directory
PRICE_MIGRATION.OVERWRITE_HINT: Without this, only items with no price — or whose Cost text changed since the last parse — are updated.
PRICE_MIGRATION.RESULT: Price migration: {scanned} scanned, {updated} updated, {skipped} unchanged, {failed} unparsed.

MERCHANT.NAME: Merchant
MERCHANT.EMPTY: This merchant has nothing for sale.
MERCHANT.DROP_HINT: Drag items or a folder here to stock the merchant.
MERCHANT.NO_BUYER: Select a single token or assign a character to buy with.
MERCHANT.NO_PRICE: This item has no price set.
MERCHANT.NOT_ENOUGH_COINS: Not enough coins for this purchase.
MERCHANT.OUT_OF_STOCK: This item is out of stock.
MERCHANT.NO_ACTIVE_GM: No active GM — purchases cannot be processed right now.
MERCHANT.PURCHASE_FAILED: The purchase could not be completed.
MERCHANT.REROLL_HINT: Re-roll availability and quantity for everything in stock. Items that come up unavailable are removed.
MERCHANT.CLEAR_CONFIRM: Remove every item from this merchant?
MERCHANT.NO_ACTIVE_CHARACTER: Select a single token or assign a character to trade with.
MERCHANT.SELL_DROP_HINT: Drag items from your inventory here to offer them for sale.
MERCHANT.SELL_EMPTY: You haven't added anything to sell yet.
MERCHANT.SELL_SUBMITTED: Your offer has been sent to the GM.
MERCHANT.SELL_ACCEPTED: The merchant paid you for your items.
MERCHANT.SELL_REJECTED: The merchant declined your offer. You can edit and resend it.
MERCHANT.SELL_NO_ITEMS: Add at least one item before selling.
MERCHANT.SELL_NO_PRICE_ITEM: This item has no price and cannot be sold here.
MERCHANT.SELL_ALREADY_IN_CART: This item is already on your list.
MERCHANT.REPAIR_DROP_HINT: Drag damaged items here to see the repair cost.
MERCHANT.REPAIR_NOT_DAMAGED: This item is already at full condition.
MERCHANT.REPAIR_NOT_ENOUGH_COINS: Not enough coins to repair these items.
MERCHANT.REPAIR_DISABLED: This merchant does not offer repairs.

SETTINGS.TITLE: Merchant Settings
SETTINGS.SELL_MODIFIER_HINT: Adjusts the price this merchant charges players when buying goods, and the cost of repairs.
SETTINGS.BUY_MODIFIER_HINT: Adjusts the price this merchant offers players for items sold to it.
SETTINGS.REPAIR_ENABLED_HINT: Lets players pay this merchant to restore damaged items to full condition.

ROLL.WARNING_NO_TARGET: No target selected for this attack.
ROLL.WARNING_NOT_TARGET_OWNER: You are not an owner of the target actor.
ROLL.WARNING_ACTION_FAILED: Action failed. See console for details.
ROLL.WARNING_INVALID_DAMAGE_TYPE: Could not apply damage: invalid damage type.
ROLL.WARNING_INVALID_DAMAGE_ATTRIBUTE: Could not apply damage: target has no valid damage attribute.
ROLL.WARNING_PARRY_NO_SHIELD_RANGED: Cannot parry a ranged attack without an equipped shield.
ROLL.WARNING_PARRY_NO_WEAPON: Cannot parry without an equipped melee weapon with Parrying.

CALENDAR.TITLE: Calendar
CALENDAR.STRONG_PHASE_HINT: This phase contains two full moons and strongly influences the events of the year.

ENABLED.NAME: Enable calendar
ENABLED.HINT: Enable the built-in Forbidden Lands calendar and its scene-control button.

VISIBLE.NAME: Calendar visible to players
VISIBLE.HINT: Allow players to open and view the calendar. The GM can always change the time; players only view it.

BANNERS.NAME: Festival banners
BANNERS.HINT: Show a banner to every player 10 days, 3 days and on the day of each festival.

CONFIG.MENU_HINT: Configure the calendar phases, lunar cycle, and set the current date and time.
CONFIG.TITLE: Calendar Setup
CONFIG.LUNAR_EPOCH: Lunar epoch (day index of a new moon)
CONFIG.LUNAR_EPOCH_HINT: Day index that is a new moon. Adjust to align the moon phases with your campaign.
CONFIG.SET_CURRENT_HINT: These fields reflect the calendar's current date and time. Change them and press Save to update the calendar.

strongholdAutomation.NAME: Stronghold automation
strongholdAutomation.HINT: Simulate production, wages, spoilage, livestock and reminders for every stronghold whenever in-game time advances.

strongholdRequireStaff.NAME: Require staff
strongholdRequireStaff.HINT: Buildings only produce when a matching hireling (or a PC marked as working there) is present. Off: buildings produce whenever they are switched on.

strongholdChatMode.NAME: Stronghold chat report
strongholdChatMode.HINT: How production reports are posted to chat.

strongholdChatGMOnly.NAME: Reports to GM only
strongholdChatGMOnly.HINT: Whisper stronghold reports and reminders to the GM instead of posting them publicly.

strongholdReminders.NAME: Weekly reminders
strongholdReminders.HINT: Post weekly reminders: stronghold events, upkeep, unguarded stronghold, mine collapse and hunter attacks.

strongholdEventTable.NAME: Stronghold events table
strongholdEventTable.HINT: UUID of a RollTable linked from the weekly events reminder (Gamemaster's Guide p.12). Leave empty for no link.

strongholdSpoilage.NAME: Food spoilage
strongholdSpoilage.HINT: Perishable goods in a stronghold spoil after their shelf life (ten times longer with a Root Cellar).

strongholdSpoilageWarnDays.NAME: Spoilage warning (days)
strongholdSpoilageWarnDays.HINT: Warn this many days before goods with a shelf life of a week or more spoil. 0 turns warnings off.

autoDefenseRating.NAME: Automatic Defense Rating
autoDefenseRating.HINT: Calculate the stronghold's Defense Rating from its guards, defensive buildings and the situational flags.

DEFENSE.PCS: PCs take part in the defense

CARD.TITLE: Stronghold report
CARD.NO_HARVEST: {name} was not worked this year: no harvest.

NONPAY.TITLE: Non-payment
NONPAY.BODY: The treasury could not pay these hirelings. Roll a D6 for each:

EVENTS.TITLE: Time to roll for events
EVENTS.BODY: Word of the stronghold spreads. Reputation, a Gallows and unpaid hirelings can modify the roll. Roll only while the stronghold is guarded (Player's Handbook p.176).

UPKEEP.TITLE: Upkeep
UPKEEP.BODY: A week has passed without a Handyman. One PC must spend a Quarter Day on upkeep and roll CRAFTING; on a failure roll on the table:

UNGUARDED.TITLE: Unguarded stronghold
UNGUARDED.BODY: No guards and no PCs are present. Roll on the table for this week:

MINE_COLLAPSE.TITLE: Tunnel collapse check
MINE_COLLAPSE.BODY: A week of work has passed in the mine. Roll one Gear Die; a 1 means a collapse. Then roll a Gear Die for each worker: a 1 means that worker is trapped (an NPC dies).

HUNTER_ATTACK.TITLE: Hunter: wild beast attack
HUNTER_ATTACK.BODY: A week of hunting has passed. Roll one Base Die per hunter; a 1 means a beast attacks. Roll again: another 1 means the hunter is killed.

NONPAY.1: The hireling leaves and spreads rumors of your stinginess: add two dice to the next stronghold event roll.
NONPAY.2: The hireling leaves and steals something valuable (GM decides).
NONPAY.3: The hireling rallies all hirelings, and they all desert.
NONPAY.4: The hireling stays but does no work until paid. Roll again if still unpaid after a week.
NONPAY.5: The hireling keeps working but spreads rumors: Reputation counts as one step higher for the next event roll. Roll again weekly.
NONPAY.6: The hireling keeps working without complaint. Roll again weekly.

UPKEEP.1: Fire destroys D6 random functions. Roll a D6 per hireling; a 1 means that hireling dies.
UPKEEP.2: A random function is ruined and must be rebuilt.
UPKEEP.3: A hireling takes a critical injury (blunt trauma).
UPKEEP.5: Leaky roof. In Winter or Fall everyone suffers cold. Repair takes a Quarter Day and a CRAFTING roll.

UNGUARDED.1: A prince or orc chieftain occupies it; all hirelings flee; 2D6 hostile soldiers hold it.
UNGUARDED.2: Rival adventurers take it; the hirelings flee.
UNGUARDED.3: Harpies nest, eat all Food, steal shiny things and chase off the hirelings. The stronghold must be cleared and cleaned again.
UNGUARDED.4: A Gray Bear makes a den; the hirelings stay but avoid it.
UNGUARDED.5: Wanderers make a mess and steal 2D6 Food.

JUMP.TITLE: Large time jump
JUMP.BODY: You are jumping {days} day(s) forward. How should the strongholds handle the gap?
JUMP.HINT: Simulate runs every Quarter Day (production, wages, spoilage, births, reminders). Skip moves the clock without changing anything. Cancel rolls the time back.

TREASURY.INVALID: The transfer could not be completed.
TREASURY.DENIED: You do not have permission for this transfer.
TREASURY.NO_TREASURY: The treasury does not hold that much.
TREASURY.NO_GM: A GM must be online to move treasury funds.
TREASURY.NO_CHARACTER: Assign a character or select a single token first.

SHEET.NO_PERMISSION: You do not have permission to change this stronghold.
SHEET.TARGET: Maximum output per working Quarter Day (up to {max})

ERROR.TICK: Stronghold automation failed for {name}. See the browser console (F12) for details.
